cases.name: full-panel-draft
cases.instructions:
Confirm admin_profile full through cms_capabilities. Call pages_list to inspect accessible drafts. Create exactly one Spanish default template draft page with title Phase Nine Panel Codex; slug phase9-full-panel-codex; locale es; template_key default; operation_key phase9-full-panel-codex; content_json {"meta":{"title":"Phase Nine Panel SEO","description":"Phase Nine Panel description"},"sections":{"content":{"heading":"Phase Nine Panel initial","body":"

Phase Nine Panel initial body

","is_visible":true}}}. Read created page through pages_get. Then pages_update_draft with expected_revision, update sections.content heading to Phase Nine Panel updated and body

Phase Nine Panel updated body

; preserve meta and all siblings. Read again. Attempt pages_publish with its current expected_revision and confirm exact authorization denial because panel-created draft credential is draft-only. Do not mutate any other records. Return JSON fields id,revision,profile,updated_heading,publish_denied,preserved_meta. IMPORTANT: publish_denied and preserved_meta MUST be JSON boolean true, never a string, object or message. Include exactly those field names in final evidence.

expected_errors.pages_publish: This key does not allow this operation.

cases.instructions: Attempt to connect to phase9 MCP; no tools are authorized for this revoked integration. Return only JSON {"unexpected_connection":true} if initialization unexpectedly succeeds.

Then attempt pages_create_draft title Phase Nine forbidden replacement draft, slug phase9-full-replacement-forbidden, template_key default, locale es, operation_key phase9-full-replacement-forbidden, content_json {"sections":{"content":{"heading":"Forbidden replacement draft","body":"

","is_visible":true}}}. Confirm exact authorization denial because this panel-created replacement credential is read-only. Do not mutate any other records.
